risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cord and plug end.

risks.risk: Water inlet/outlet hoses may be missing, cracked, or leaking.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of the unit showing hose connections.

risks.risk: Cosmetic yellowing/staining visible on casing suggests age; unclear if it affects function.
risks.proof: Already visible in photo 0; no further proof needed, cosmetic only.

Photo of the open lid showing the drum/agitator interior.
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug.
Photo of the rear panel showing inlet/outlet hoses.
Any visible rating plate or model/serial sticker, if present elsewhere on the unit.
response.reason: Brand (Nexus) and item type (single-tub washing machine) are identifiable from the photo, but no functional test or interior view is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as non-working/unverified until proof of operation is given.
